facts.fact: The document says NimbaPay, Guinea's national instant payment system, was developed under the leadership of the Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea (BCRG), implemented by Guineenne de Monetique, and launched on 23 July 2026.

systems.owner: BCRG, implemented by Guineenne de Monetique

GIN.note: No licensing or regional link stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.
Cross-border payments are only named as an upcoming NimbaPay phase, not piloted or licensed.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The document says NimbaPay, launched on 23 July 2026, lets customers of participating banks, electronic money institutions and microfinance institutions make instant transfers between accounts regardless of institution.
The document describes NimbaPay as Guinea's national instant payment system connecting banks and electronic money institutions, launched on 23 July 2026.

systems.owner: BCRG, implemented by Guineenne de Monetique

GIN.note: Payments to public administrations are only named as an upcoming phase.
